checks.description: The importing P5 Lottery styleguide entry exists.
The machine-readable P5 Lottery system-decision ledger exists.

The source modules, styleguide files, and decision ledger are present, nonempty, and parse as JavaScript where applicable. The ledger supports truthful no-candidate promote/prune decisions and requires a named local behavior owner.

In a browser and the published source, verify that the styleguide imports the real modules, all three contexts are visible, five-number selection, deterministic roll, ticket bounds, submit guard, approval and rejection work locally, status has text plus a non-color cue, and the paper-slip language feels continuous with the pinned upstream source. This review judges source architecture and visual taste; the automatic validator does not.
